correctness.rationale: Exact adjacent-window difference identity fixes the integer difference to gcd(n,ell) residue cycles; binary constraints freeze all mixed cycles, and equality of one window sum is exactly conservation of pure-one cycle count. This proves binomial fibers, every multiplicity, singleton and extremal counts. Summing weighted mixed patterns and pure classes proves a true polynomial fixed-weight output enumerator; all n>=2 and 1<=ell<=n, including ell=n and ell=1, are covered. The standalone exact enumerator checked 425984 binary source instances over all n<=14 and all window sizes; independently implemented inverse check covered 3036 output cases. Finite checks only corroborate the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The 2024 weighted-read source treats finite linear, not periodic, windows; the 2023 transverse-read primary explicitly sets aside its cyclic analogue. The complete cyclic fiber partition, numerical class-count law, exact weight polynomial and arithmetic rate transition were not implied by any inspected source. Published results on noncyclic transverse fibers, unindexed composition multisets and low-frequency DFT sampling concern distinct observation maps. Remaining priority risk under alternate boxcar convolution terminology is acknowledged; absence of a hit alone is not the reason for originality.
residual_risks: A mathematically equivalent combinatorial enumeration may occur under unindexed circulant convolution or inverse discrete tomography terminology; targeted queries and inspected closest full texts do not exclude all prior literature.
Other observations, such as unknown origin or aggregated spectra, are not covered by this result.

value.rationale: The complete finite-length ambiguity distribution and exact zero-error capacity are natural missing invariants for an explicitly recognized cyclic version of binary weighted-read channels. The constant-composition polynomial has direct constrained-coding significance and is not implied by a channel rate alone. The gcd threshold produces sharp injectivity and macroscopic resonant information-rate loss, while the full inverse-fiber formula gives exact decoder list sizes and extremizers. No claim about noisy channels is made.
